description: Find all elements matching a strategy and selector. Returns JSON {elements: [{elementId, attributes?}]}; no matches returns {elements: []}. Pass an elementId as elementUUID to interaction tools. Additional driver attributes are preserved. For drivers supporting elementResponseAttributes, use appium_driver_settings to configure it with shouldUseCompactResponses=false. Use appium_find_element when only one match is needed.

selector.description: Selector for the strategy. Do not pass natural-language descriptions; use appium_ai action=find_element for vision.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

strategy.description:
accessibility id: cross-platform, fast and stable. id: Android resource-id; iOS accessibility-id alias.
iOS prefer accessibility id > -ios predicate string > -ios class chain; Android prefer accessibility id > id > -android uiautomator. Use xpath last (slow/brittle).
name: legacy; class name: broad matches; css selector: webview only.

name: appium_find_elements
